name: Loftis Steel & Aluminum, Inc.
old_description: A Cut Above the Rest: Your Trusted Steel & Aluminum Distributor
about:
Loftis Steel & Aluminum, Inc. was founded in 2000 as a family-owned business in Nashville, Tennessee. The company began as a metals distributor and has grown into a regional supplier with a partnership with Tennessee Die Supply, operating from its Nashville facility to serve the Southeast.

The company stocks a diverse inventory of aluminum, steel, and tool steels, and provides in-house processing services including precision laser cutting, waterjet cutting, CAD design and print clean-up, and delivery via its own trucks and shipping partners. Four CAD engineers support customer projects, and the facility emphasizes an employee-centric culture to maintain quality.

Loftis serves a broad range of industries including aerospace, automotive, construction, energy, firearms, government, machine shops, general manufacturing, medical, and oil & gas. Customers range from local machine shops and auto parts manufacturers to government agencies.

The company differentiates itself through its family-owned legacy, experienced team, and a commitment to speed—claiming up to 50 percent faster turnaround than competitors—while maintaining meticulous attention to detail.
